intent.proves: At least one email has recipients with a sent time.
intent.scope: all emails; recipients joined through the message id or the original message id

bindings.reason: Handler not reserved: needs a field-predicate projection over the tool's rows; mcp-count counts rows only. Predicate: isSent = true.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.EmailId) FROM EmailMarketingEmail e INNER JOIN EmailRecipient r ON (r.RecipientMessageId = e.EmailMessageId OR r.RecipientMessageId = e.EmailOriginalMessageId) WHERE r.RecipientSentTime IS NOT NULL

sources.ref: nuget Dynamicweb.EmailMarketing 10.29.8 (table and column names in assembly SQL strings)
